entries.subject: DAMIT 4269: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 4269, version 2019-05-07, pole (21°, 20°), period 7.36014 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 4270 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 198.77 ± 5.597 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 198.77 ± 5.597 km, from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 744, 197; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "99.39 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 203, DAMIT model 4270 diameter 173 ± 2 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 4270 fitted to 2 occultations); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Chicago whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 14 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.934 at 462 nm, 1.015 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3a3936 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.1% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.7%), from NEOWISE (Grav et al. 2012, ApJ 744, 197; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
